title: Story pack: Decoded #13 lands tomorrow (Budget Season)
hook: Finance funds what it can measure. Creative usually arrives without a measure.
caption:
Story pack (no feed caption).

Teases Decoded #13: Budget Season: Making the Case for Creative Spend to Finance, out tomorrow. Frame 2 says why it matters. Frame 3 lists the three numbers finance already understands. Frame 4 is the question box. Frame 5 asks people to subscribe so it reaches their inbox.
alt_text: Five vertical story frames. Frame 1: Tomorrow, Decoded #13, Budget Season: Making the Case for Creative Spend to Finance. Frame 2: finance funds what it can measure. Frame 3 lists three numbers finance already understands: cost per order by creative attribute, spend that taught you nothing, and time to a new winner. Frame 4 asks what finance asks you about creative spend. Frame 5: get it in your inbox tomorrow, subscribe free.
